Rheumatology Follow-up
Patient: Hugo Castellano | DOB: 01/17/1996 | MRN: SYN-9898256
Date of service: 07/07/2025 | Dr. Ravi Langley, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
29-year-old man with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2024, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: gastroesophageal reflux, hyperlipidemia.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 20 mg weekly for 15 weeks despite good adherence.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis with high disease activity, CDAI 33.
Pre-biologic screening: tuberculosis and hepatitis B screens negative.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
